items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Saturday night, the 26th of April I played this session with Dicky Wells, Eddie Barefield, the great Willie "the Lion" Smith and two drummers, Jo Jones and Panama Francis.

ctx.x: Saturday nights there was always a session at Central Plaza on East 3rd street which was run by Jack Crystal who at one time managed the sessions for Milt Gabler at Jimmie Rhyan on 52nd street. Jack was a real friend to all jazz musicians regardless of race or religion and his sessions were often a big help to many of the fellows that played them.
Saturday night, the 26th of April I played this session with Dicky Wells, Eddie Barefield, the great Willie "the Lion" Smith and two drummers, Jo Jones and Panama Francis.

I was on vacation and not looking for work, beside I hadn't blown for quite a while, but I was really happy to have been engaged for this session, which was the only time I really wanted to play during my visit to the Apple. The Lion was a regular must at the Plaza and I was told that he was there for every session. I was happy playing with my ole buddy Dickie Wells and the rest of the fellows and they were well pleased to play with me and to know that I had not lost anything concerning my style and ideas as most…
